# Faris Munir Mahdi

> Software Engineer. Fullstack software engineer with over a year of professional experience building and maintaining applications, including their infrastructure and AI integrations, for day-to-day production use. I work in TypeScript, Rust, Go, and Python, on APIs, databases, LLM orchestration, and containerized deployments.
